bsc5.csv.source: Yale Bright Star Catalogue 5th rev. ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), VizieR V/50
bsc5.csv.query: SELECT HR, Name, RAJ2000, DEJ2000, Vmag, "B-V" FROM "V/50/catalog" WHERE Vmag <= 6.5 AND RAJ2000 IS NOT NULL
bsc5.csv.terms: VizieR/CDS: free use with acknowledgement of CDS and the catalogue authors

planets_pscomppars.csv.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems Composite Parameters
planets_pscomppars.csv.query: SELECT hostname, pl_name, pl_letter, pl_orbper, pl_orbsmax, pl_rade, pl_radj, pl_bmasse, pl_orbeccen, pl_eqt, pl_orbper_reflink, pl_rade_reflink, st_teff, st_rad, st_mass, st_spectype, sy_dist, disc_year, discoverymethod, tran_flag FROM pscomppars WHERE hostname IN ('HD 39091', 'HD 209458', 'WASP-12', 'TRAPPIST-1', 'GJ 1214', '51 Peg', 'AU Mic', 'WASP-126', 'DS Tuc A', 'iot Hor', 'Proxima Cen') ORDER BY hostname, pl_orbper
planets_pscomppars.csv.note: pscomppars mixes values from several references per planet; pl_orbper_reflink and pl_rade_reflink name the period and radius references
planets_pscomppars.csv.terms: NASA Exoplanet Archive: public; acknowledge per archive policy

gaia_density_hpx5_g11.csv.query: SELECT hpx, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(x) AS x, AVG(y) AS y, AVG(z) AS z FROM (SELECT GAIA_HEALPIX_INDEX(5, source_id) AS hpx, COS(RADIANS(dec))*COS(RADIANS(ra)) AS x, COS(RADIANS(dec))*SIN(RADIANS(ra)) AS y, SIN(RADIANS(dec)) AS z FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 11) AS t GROUP BY hpx
gaia_density_hpx5_g11.csv.note: cell centre = mean unit vector of member sources
gaia_density_hpx5_g11.csv.terms: ESA Gaia data: CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO; acknowledge ESA/Gaia/DPAC
